text:
deploy-bot: v2 progressive roll starting 08:50 UTC. initial ramp 2% -> 10% over 20m. New: response envelope wrapper + stricter chunk-size validation. Pinlists in effect: tenant-exclude.csv.
rachel: FYI the envelope adds a top-level metadata object — most clients are fine but some proxies strip unknown top-level keys. saw a repro in staging for tenant 'harbor' where client expects plain text body.
devin: confirmed in staging: harbor had 0.7% 400s and some clients got back JSON instead of raw stream body; those clients error out.
ops-sam: monitor alerted slice 5 at 08:56 UTC, 5xx spike to 0.9% for harbor paths. auto-pause kicked in.
deploy-bot: rollout paused for affected slices at 08:57 UTC. traffic for those slices reverted to v1.
priya: recommend immediate pin for harbor + quark. pin API: (ops token required)
```
curl -X POST https://deploy.internal/pin \\
  -H "Authorization: Bearer $OP" \\
  -H "Content-Type: application/json" \\
  -d '{"tenant":"harbor","route":"/v2","version":"v1","reason":"v2 response envelope breaking some proxies","expires":"2026-04-10T00:00:00Z"}'
```
ben: applied pin for harbor and quark via UI; deploy-bot acknowledged in 21s. telemetry shows harbor 5xx down to 0.03% after 3m.
cs-kate: CS ping: I'll notify Harbor support contacts with mitigation steps and link to staging endpoint for testing.
rachel: short-term fix options: 1) revert envelope (big), 2) add header opt-out for raw-body (smaller), 3) recommend pin until SDK patch. prefer 2.
devin: we can add a passthrough header X-Redwood-Response-Mode: raw to bypass envelope for compatible clients. small release and canary.
ops-sam: ops runbook: escalation if pinned tenants >6% canary capacity OR any tenant >1% 5xx for 5m -> schedule rollback window (30m) and page oncall. adding to notes.
deploy-bot: pinlist updated; pinned tenants excluded from v2. canary resumed for unaffected tenants.
priya: release notes: add Compatibility section: "v2 wraps responses in a metadata envelope by default. If your client expects raw stream bodies, pin to v1 or set header X-Redwood-Response-Mode: raw. SDKs will add convenience flags in 1.4.3." include pin curl sample.
ben: dev plan: cut small feature flag to allow passthrough header, run narrow canary limited to tenants on legacy proxies. ETA for patch -> PR today, canary in 45m pending CI.
cs-kate: I'll prep tenant email template referencing incident INC-2026-777 and how to pin, plus SDK timeline.
rachel: after passthrough is live, we'll re-run harbor in narrow canary (<=2 tenants per slice) and monitor for 30m before broader ramp.
devin: note for QA: include proxy that strips unknown top-level JSON keys in test matrix. we missed that earlier.
ops-sam: monitoring watch set for 90m. paging thresholds in place.
ben: merging PR to feature-flag branch now. will update when CI green.
priya: adding rollback criteria and pin instructions to the release notes draft and ops checklist.
cs-kate: tenant outreach queued, will send once narrow canary shows green.
deploy-bot: monitoring update: harbor 5xx reduced to 0.02% after pin. canary health stable for non-pinned slices.
rachel: thanks team. keep this thread for rollout coordination and release notes edits. :white_check_mark:
